subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `announceTarget: "parent"` as a native `sessions_spawn` mode whose completion intentionally never falls back to the external channel when the requester session cannot be awakened?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately narrow and has focused proof, but selecting a model-facing delivery mode that can retain a completed result internally is a permanent user-visible orchestration policy, not a mechanical correctness choice.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow opt-in mode
options.body: Accept the per-spawn-only API, preserve the omitted/default route, and require rebased proof of the fail-closed and restart-recovery behavior before merge.

options.title: Defer native completion routing
options.body: Keep the current completion-delivery contract and close or pause this PR if strict internal-only fan-in should remain an owner/plugin-level orchestration pattern.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow opt-in mode
recommendation.body: Accept the per-spawn-only API, preserve the omitted/default route, and require rebased proof of the fail-closed and restart-recovery behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work spans the affected spawn, handoff, and subagent lifecycle surfaces.
